verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
Guide us to the straight path —

verses.arabic: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
verses.translation: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked Your anger or of those who are astray.
verses.transliteration: Siratal lazeena an'amta 'alayhim ghayril maghdubi 'alayhim wa lad daaleen

verses.translation: By time,
Indeed, mankind is in loss,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
verses.translation: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
verses.transliteration: Illal lazeena aamanu wa amiluS saalihaati wa tawasaw bil haqqi wa tawasaw bis sabr

verses.translation: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,

verses.arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
verses.translation: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
verses.transliteration: Wa ra-aytan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwaaja

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
verses.translation: Then exalt Him with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
verses.transliteration: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wastaghfirh innahu kaana tawwaaba

verses.translation: Say, He is Allah, [who is] One,
Allah, the Eternal Refuge.
He neither begets nor is born,
Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
verses.transliteration: Wa lam yakul lahoo kufuwan ahad

verses.translation: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh —
Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer —
Let them worship the Lord of this House,

verses.arabic: الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ
verses.translation: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
verses.transliteration: Allazi at'amahum min joo'in wa aamanahum min khawf

verses.translation: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
verses.transliteration: Tabbat yadaa abi lahabiw wa tabb

verses.arabic: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verses.translation: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
verses.transliteration: Maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa maa kasab

verses.translation: He will [soon] enter a Fire of blazing flame
And his wife [as well] — the carrier of firewood.
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ
verses.translation: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
verses.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa fa'ala rabbuka bi-as-haabil feel

verses.translation: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
And He sent against them birds in flocks,
Striking them with stones of hard clay,
And He made them like eaten straw.
Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer —
Those who make show [of their deeds]
And withhold [simple] assistance.
Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
And We removed from you your burden
Which had weighed upon your back
And raised high for you your repute.
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
By the morning brightness
And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
verses.transliteration: Maa wadda'aka rabbuka wa maa qalaa

verses.translation: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
And He found you lost and guided [you],
And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
Indeed, We sent the Quran down during the Night of Decree.
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
verses.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka maa laylatul qadr

verses.arabic: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
verses.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
verses.transliteration: Laylatul qadri khayrum min alfi shahr

verses.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
verses.translation: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
verses.transliteration: Tanazzalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feehaa bi-izni rabbihim min kulli amr

verses.translation: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
verses.transliteration: Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr

verses.translation: Say, O disbelievers,
I do not worship what you worship.
Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.

words.meaning: and for me is my religion

verses.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
From the evil of that which He created
And from the evil of darkness when it settles
verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri ghaasiqin iza waqab

verses.translation: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
verses.transliteration: Wa min sharrin naffaasaati fil uqad

verses.translation: And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri haasidin iza hasad

verses.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
The Sovereign of mankind.
The God of mankind,
From the evil of the retreating whisperer
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind —
From among the jinn and mankind.
Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
Until you visit the graveyards.
No! You are going to know.
Then, no! You are going to know.
No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
You will surely see the Hellfire.
Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
And the earth discharges its burdens
And man says, 'What is [wrong] with it?' —
That Day, it will report its news
Because your Lord has commanded it.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ
verses.translation: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.

verses.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
verses.translation: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
verses.transliteration: Faman ya'mal mithqala zarratin khayray yarah

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
verses.translation: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
verses.transliteration: Wa may ya'mal mithqala zarratin sharrayy yarah

verses.translation: Woe to every scorner and mocker
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
Which mounts directed at the hearts.
Indeed, it will be closed down upon them
In extended columns.

verses.arabic: لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ
verses.translation: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not going to desist until there came to them clear evidence —
verses.transliteration: Lam yakunil lazeena kafaroo min ahlil kitaabi wal mushrikeena munfakkeena hatta ta-tiyahumul bayyinah

verses.arabic: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ يَتْلُو صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
verses.translation: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures
Within which are correct writings.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ
verses.translation: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
verses.transliteration: Wa ma tafarraqal lazeena ootul kitaba illa mim ba'di ma jaa-at humul bayyinah

verses.arabic: وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ حُنَفَاءَ وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ
verses.translation: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
verses.transliteration: Wa maa umiroo illa liya'budul laaha mukhliseena lahud deena hunafaa-a wa yuqeemus salaata wa yu-tuz zakaata wa zalika deenul qayyimah

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أُولَٰئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ
verses.translation: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
verses.transliteration: Innal lazeena kafaroo min ahlil kitaabi wal mushrikeena fee naari jahannama khalideena feeha ulaa-ika hum sharrul bareeyah

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ
verses.translation: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds — those are the best of creatures.
verses.transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa amiluS saalihaati ulaa-ika hum khayrul bareeyah

verses.arabic: جَزَاؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا رَّضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُ
verses.translation: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
verses.transliteration: Jazaa-uhum inda rabbihim jannaatu adnin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khalideena feeha abadan radiyal laahu anhum wa radoo anh, zaalika liman khashiya rabbah

verses.translation: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
Who created and proportioned
And who destined and [then] guided
And who brings out the pasture
And [then] makes it black stubble.
We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
verses.translation: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
verses.transliteration: Illa ma shaa-allaahu innahu ya'lamul jahra wa ma yakhfa

verses.translation: And We will ease you toward ease.
So remind, if the reminder should benefit,
The one who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
But the most wretched one will avoid it —
Who will [then] enter the greatest Fire,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.translation: Neither dying therein nor living.
verses.transliteration: Thumma la yamootu feeha wa la yahya

verses.translation: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
But you prefer the worldly life,
While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
By the sky and the night comer —
And what can make you know what is the night comer?
It is the piercing star!

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
verses.translation: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
verses.transliteration: In kullu nafsin lamma alayhaa hafiz

verses.translation: So let man observe from what he was created.
He was created from a fluid, ejected,
Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
verses.translation: Then he will have no power and no helper.
verses.transliteration: Fama lahu min quwwatiw wa la naasir

verses.translation: By the sky which returns [rain]
And [by] the earth which cracks open,
Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
And it is not amusement.
Indeed, they are planning a plan,
And I am planning a plan.
So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
